comment.body:
This is quite an expensive database migration to run; (a) it's not implemented very efficiently as every repository requires a second query, and (b) it rewrites the entire repository table, row-by-row, without even a condition on whether the rewrite has an impact on the row (e.g. where the topics are already correct).  This is quite expensive on a large-scale instance like Codeberg.

I don't think this has value relative to the upgrade time spent on it
